reason: Revised per REV-20261001-04: any restructure or model adoption now has to clear a quality and wrong-reject floor against the deployed gate (A0), otherwise the gate is retained; wrong-reject is labelled a screen with safety provisional and shadow only until a one-sided bound is shown; repeat-call cost is separated from serving cost; the freeze bundle contents are listed as a hard precondition.
